artist.name: NERIAH
artist.place_of_origin: Los Angeles and Malibu, California, United States
artist.short_description: NERIAH — an Afterglow curated emotional-pop discovery profile.
artist.biography: NERIAH is an American pop singer-songwriter associated with Los Angeles and Malibu. A 2023 profile from the songwriter organization BMI identifies both places as part of her upbringing and reports that she began writing music as a child. The profile also notes early online activity and a growing catalogue that included ‘Lego Blocks,’ ‘Unfinished Business,’ and ‘AT LEAST I’M GOOD AT IT.’ Her official music-service catalogue shows a steady sequence of releases rather than a single breakthrough-only discography. In 2022 she released the projects ‘This Is How the World Made Me’ and ‘How Do I Get Clean?,’ the latter including ‘Unfinished Business’ and ‘Fuck You Matthew.’ Her music also moved into full-length album territory with 2023’s ‘Cause of Death,’ followed by later singles and the 2025 project ‘Reason To Hate You.’ A public Apple Music listing identifies subsequent titles such as ‘Out of Your League’ and the 2026 single ‘Not Tonight.’ For Afterglow, NERIAH is an editorial fit for the confrontational and emotionally candid end of pop: songs that can carry the directness of diary entries without limiting the listening experience to acoustic ballads. This is a stylistic assessment based on her reported genres and catalogued work, not a claim that the artist defines herself exclusively by any particular heartbreak theme. Song-level interpretations should remain absent unless source-specific evidence supports them.
